//: stylelint-config-standard supplies the correctness rules (unknown properties, duplicate selectors, deprecated values). Four of its stylistic opinions are turned off below because this repository deliberately does not follow them, so `npm run lint:css` reports only debt Phase 5 intends to clear and the flip from warnings to errors needs no disable comments. declaration-block-single-line-max-declarations and rule-empty-line-before: app/globals.css writes short rules on one line and groups them without blank lines on purpose. no-descending-specificity: a cascade built on breakpoint overrides trips it by design, and reordering the file to satisfy it would move pixels for no benefit. media-feature-range-notation: it contradicts media-feature-name-allowed-list below, which permits only max-width, so satisfying either would fail the other.

selector-class-pattern.message: Expected kebab-case or BEM in app/globals.css, camelCase in a CSS module
